categories.name: Person
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including historical figures, politicians, artists, athletes, and fictional characters.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Groups of people such as companies, institutions, government bodies, political parties, sports teams, and religious organizations.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities including countries, cities, towns, islands, regions, bodies of water, and astronomical locations.

categories.name: Facility
categories.definition: Man-made structures and sites such as buildings, stadiums, airports, bridges, roads, and railway lines.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Occurrences, incidents, battles, wars, competitions, and conferences that happen at a specific time and place.

categories.name: Work of Art
categories.definition: Creative works including films, books, songs, television shows, theatrical productions, and visual artworks.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: Manufactured goods, vehicles, weapons, food items, and commercial products.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: Prizes, honors, and distinctions given to individuals or organizations for achievement.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Systems of communication used by a community or nation.

categories.name: Disease
categories.definition: Medical conditions, disorders, and syndromes affecting health.

categories.name: Chemical Substance
categories.definition: Chemical elements, compounds, drugs, and biological molecules.

categories.name: Biological Taxon
categories.definition: Groups of biological organisms such as families, genera, or species.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: Systems of money in general use in a particular country.

categories.name: Nationality
categories.definition: Status of belonging to a particular nation or adjective denoting this status.

categories.name: Title
categories.definition: Names of positions, ranks, or honorifics held by individuals.

categories.name: Software
categories.definition: Computer programs, operating systems, and digital platforms.

categories.name: Academic Degree
categories.definition: Qualifications awarded to students upon successful completion of a course of study.

categories.name: Abbreviation
categories.definition: Shortened forms of words or phrases.
